profile.summary: One on One Basketball provides basketball instruction and event management in the United States and abroad. Its programs include after-school programs, player development, camps, leagues, personal training and special events. It started in 1991 and was incorporated in 1992, and is based in the Washington, D.C. area with regional offices in other areas, including the San Francisco East Bay.
